title: A personal space: one private conversation with Sophia, notes the person keeps, and notes carried to a project one at a time
why: Luis's direction C (docs/goals/personal-space.md, PR #21): everyone who signs up has a private space with Sophia beside the work space. Personal data lives in its own owner-only tables (0021), never in project tables with a flag; no project role reaches it.

The only crossing is a per-item release (carryPersonalNote): one note, exactly as written, to one project the person belongs to; members read it attributed to its owner, who can take it back. The team companion reads nothing personal (D5 kept at no until Davide confirms).

Sophia's replies come from the companion the API runs. This slice ships a keyless rehearsal (scripted, development only); the runtime's Companion agent (D1) replaces it without changing these operations. Where none runs, sending is refused with nothing kept. listProjects gives the Work side its list; the contract had none.
